claim: Descriptive serial development medians; not paired confidence, multiple-comparison corrected superiority or final acceptance
memory: Peak RSS includes the full process fixture, inputs, oracle and output storage; not library-only heap memory
cpu: Whole-process CPU includes setup, warmup and checks outside the timing interval; Darwin time output has 0.01-second granularity, including rounded zero values
tails: Available scalar p50/p99 fields are per-process revision samples. Their process medians are development diagnostics, not validated service tail latency
